s: Phoenix delivery, member pricing on everything, and a concierge named Nora.
Account, age and ID, medical card, bank and plan, in one calm flow.

t: ID and medical card checks, live
s: Scan both sides, watch each check tick through. Simulated for the demo.

t: Link a bank, skip the cards
s: Orders are paid straight from checking.
Flower, pre-rolls, vapes, edibles, concentrates and topicals.
Potency, format, effects, bundle deals and member reviews.

t: Tap the mic and just talk
s: Voice mode: Nora listens, answers out loud, and keeps the chat on screen.

q: My back hurts. I want something relaxing under $20.

t: She searches the shelf and shows two picks
s: Listed effects, under budget. No medical claims, and a nudge to see a doctor if it keeps up.
Ask her anything, the way you'd ask a budtender.

q: I'll take the patch. Add it to my cart.
s: Added, then she points out older items still in the cart.
Three items gone in one sentence.

q: Deliver it to my home address at 8 p.m.
s: Nora confirms the plan out loud, then takes over checkout.

t: She checks out for you, in front of you
s: Home address, the 8–9 PM window, pay by bank. Every click is real, and you can stop her anytime.
Delivery window, the driver on the way, and an ID check at the door.
The same Nora over iMessage. Products arrive as tappable links.

q: My back's been sore after the gym.
s: Two topicals, each with a photo and the member price.
Added to the cart. Free delivery, ready to check out.
